# Results

```{r}
#| label: results-setup
#| include: false

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)
library(sf)
library(raster)
library(ipdw)
library(patchwork)
library(here)
library(knitr)
library(scales)

# Raw water-quality data
chla_raw <- readRDS(here("2-data", "raw", "chla_raw.rds"))
do_raw <- readRDS(here("2-data", "raw", "do.rds"))
sal_raw <- readRDS(here("2-data", "raw", "salinity_raw.rds"))
turb_raw <- readRDS(here("2-data", "raw", "turb_raw.rds"))
water_temp_raw <- readRDS(here("2-data", "raw", "water_temp_raw.rds"))

raw_data <- list(
  "Chlorophyll-a" = chla_raw,
  "Dissolved oxygen" = do_raw,
  "Salinity" = sal_raw,
  "Turbidity" = turb_raw,
  "Water temperature" = water_temp_raw
)

# Processed water-quality data
chla_proc <- readRDS(here("2-data", "processed", "chla_proc.rds"))
do_proc <- readRDS(here("2-data", "processed", "do_proc.rds"))
sal_proc <- readRDS(here("2-data", "processed", "sal_proc.rds"))
turb_proc <- readRDS(here("2-data", "processed", "turb_proc.rds"))
water_temp_proc <- readRDS(
  here("2-data", "processed", "water_temp_proc.rds")
)

processed_data <- list(
  "Chlorophyll-a" = chla_proc,
  "Dissolved oxygen" = do_proc,
  "Salinity" = sal_proc,
  "Turbidity" = turb_proc,
  "Water temperature" = water_temp_proc
)

parameter_units <- c(
  "Chlorophyll-a" = "ug/L",
  "Dissolved oxygen" = "mg/L",
  "Salinity" = "ppt",
  "Turbidity" = "NTU",
  "Water temperature" = "degrees C"
)

# Saved IPDW sensitivity results
sensitivity_results <- list(
  "Dissolved oxygen" = readRDS(
    here("2-data", "models", "do_sensitivity_test.rds")
  ),
  "Salinity" = readRDS(
    here("2-data", "models", "sal_sensitivity_test.rds")
  ),
  "Turbidity" = readRDS(
    here("2-data", "models", "turb_sensitivity_test.rds")
  ),
  "Water temperature" = readRDS(
    here("2-data", "models", "water_temp_sensitivity_test.rds")
  )
)

# Saved final IPDW validation results
model_stats <- list(
  "Dissolved oxygen" = readRDS(
    here("2-data", "models", "do_stats.rds")
  ),
  "Salinity" = readRDS(
    here("2-data", "models", "sal_stats.rds")
  ),
  "Turbidity" = readRDS(
    here("2-data", "models", "turb_stats.rds")
  ),
  "Water temperature" = readRDS(
    here("2-data", "models", "water_temp_stats.rds")
  )
)

# Saved final environmental rasters
raster_results <- list(
  "Dissolved oxygen" = readRDS(
    here("2-data", "models", "do_rast.rds")
  ),
  "Salinity" = readRDS(
    here("2-data", "models", "sal_rast.rds")
  ),
  "Turbidity" = readRDS(
    here("2-data", "models", "turb_rast.rds")
  ),
  "Water temperature" = readRDS(
    here("2-data", "models", "water_temp_rast.rds")
  )
)

study_area <- readRDS(
  here("2-data", "processed", "study_area.rds")
)

oyster_points <- readRDS(
  here("2-data", "processed", "oyster_pts_0903.rds")
)

# Values available for inline narrative statements
total_raw_observations <- sum(map_int(raw_data, nrow))

total_unique_raw_sites <- n_distinct(
  unlist(
    map(raw_data, "Location_Identifier"),
    use.names = FALSE
  ),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

total_processed_bins <- sum(map_int(processed_data, nrow))
total_oyster_points <- nrow(oyster_points)
```

## Water-Quality Data Coverage

<!--
Narrative to add:

- Report the total raw observations and unique monitoring sites.
- Describe differences in data availability among parameters.
- Refer to Table @tbl-raw-data-summary.
- Describe the effects of warm-season filtering and spatial aggregation.
- Refer to Table @tbl-processed-data-summary.
- Explain that chlorophyll-a was excluded because its retained spatial coverage was inadequate.

Useful inline values:

- Total raw observations: `r scales::comma(total_raw_observations)`
- Unique raw monitoring sites: `r scales::comma(total_unique_raw_sites)`
- Total processed spatial bins: `r scales::comma(total_processed_bins)`
-->

```{r}
#| label: tbl-raw-data-summary
#| tbl-cap: "Summary of raw water-quality data available for each environmental parameter."
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

raw_summary <- imap_dfr(
  raw_data,
  \(data, parameter) {
    result_values <- suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(as.character(data$Result_Measure))
    )

    sample_dates <- as.Date(data$Activity_StartDate)

    reported_units <- unique(
      trimws(as.character(data$Result_MeasureUnit))
    )

    reported_units <- reported_units[
      !is.na(reported_units) & reported_units != ""
    ]

    tibble(
      Parameter = parameter,
      `Total observations` = nrow(data),
      `Numeric results` = sum(!is.na(result_values)),
      `Unique stations` = n_distinct(
        data$Location_Identifier,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      `Begin date` = min(sample_dates, na.rm = TRUE),
      `End date` = max(sample_dates, na.rm = TRUE),
      `Reported units` = paste(reported_units, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }
) |>
  arrange(desc(`Total observations`)) |>
  mutate(
    across(
      c(`Total observations`, `Numeric results`, `Unique stations`),
      scales::comma
    ),
    `Begin date` = format(`Begin date`, "%m/%d/%Y"),
    `End date` = format(`End date`, "%m/%d/%Y")
  )

kable(
  raw_summary,
  booktabs = TRUE,
  align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "c", "c", "l")
)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-processed-data-summary
#| tbl-cap: "Summary of processed warm-season water-quality data used to evaluate environmental coverage and generate interpolation inputs."
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

processed_summary <- imap_dfr(
  processed_data,
  \(data, parameter) {
    tibble(
      Parameter = parameter,
      `Spatial bins` = nrow(data),
      `Unique stations` = sum(data$n_stations, na.rm = TRUE),
      `Included observations` = sum(data$total_n, na.rm = TRUE),
      `First year` = min(data$first_year, na.rm = TRUE),
      `Last year` = max(data$last_year, na.rm = TRUE),
      Units = parameter_units[[parameter]]
    )
  }
) |>
  mutate(
    across(
      c(`Spatial bins`, `Unique stations`, `Included observations`),
      scales::comma
    )
  )

kable(
  processed_summary,
  booktabs = TRUE,
  align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "c", "c", "l")
)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-monitoring-coverage
#| fig-cap: "Spatial distribution of monitoring stations represented in each raw water-quality dataset."
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

monitoring_sites <- imap_dfr(
  raw_data,
  \(data, parameter) {
    data |>
      dplyr::select(Location_Identifier, geometry) |>
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(Location_Identifier)) |>
      dplyr::group_by(Location_Identifier) |>
      dplyr::slice(1) |>
      dplyr::ungroup() |>
      dplyr::mutate(parameter = parameter)
  }
) |>
  st_as_sf() |>
  st_transform(st_crs(study_area))

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = study_area,
    fill = "grey95",
    color = "grey45",
    linewidth = 0.25
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = monitoring_sites,
    color = "#2166AC",
    size = 0.7,
    alpha = 0.65
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~parameter, ncol = 2) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```

## IPDW Parameter Sensitivity

<!--
Narrative to add:

- Describe the overall response of MAE to distance power and maximum range.
- Identify the final parameter combination used for each variable.
- Note when several combinations produced nearly equivalent error.
- Refer to Figure @fig-ipdw-sensitivity.
-->

```{r}
#| label: fig-ipdw-sensitivity
#| fig-cap: "Mean MAE across distance-power and maximum-range combinations evaluated using repeated five-fold spatial cross-validation. Red outlines identify the parameter combinations used for the final interpolation models."
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 8
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

plot_sensitivity <- function(result, stats, parameter) {
  power_levels <- sort(unique(result$summary$dist_power))
  range_levels <- sort(unique(result$summary$max_range))

  plot_data <- result$summary |>
    mutate(
      dist_power = factor(dist_power, levels = power_levels),
      max_range = factor(max_range, levels = range_levels)
    )

  selected_data <- result$summary |>
    filter(
      near(dist_power, stats$dist_power[[1]]),
      max_range == stats$max_range[[1]]
    ) |>
    mutate(
      dist_power = factor(dist_power, levels = power_levels),
      max_range = factor(max_range, levels = range_levels)
    )

  ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(
      x = dist_power,
      y = max_range,
      fill = mean_MAE
    )
  ) +
    geom_tile() +
    geom_tile(
      data = selected_data,
      fill = NA,
      color = "red",
      linewidth = 1.2
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(
        label = sprintf("%.2f", mean_MAE),
        color = mean_MAE > median(mean_MAE, na.rm = TRUE)
      ),
      size = 3
    ) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(
      direction = -1,
      name = "Mean MAE"
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("FALSE" = "black", "TRUE" = "white"),
      guide = "none"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = parameter,
      x = "Distance power",
      y = "Maximum range (m)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    )
}

sensitivity_plots <- imap(
  sensitivity_results,
  \(result, parameter) {
    plot_sensitivity(
      result = result,
      stats = model_stats[[parameter]],
      parameter = parameter
    )
  }
)

wrap_plots(sensitivity_plots, ncol = 2) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "IPDW Parameter Sensitivity Analysis",
    subtitle = "Repeated five-fold spatial cross-validation"
  )
```

## IPDW Spatial Cross-Validation Performance

<!--
Narrative to add:

- Report the selected distance power and maximum range for each parameter.
- Compare repeated mean MAE, RMSE, bias, and coverage among parameters.
- Interpret errors in the original units shown in the table.
- Describe these values as internal spatial cross-validation results.
- Refer to Table @tbl-ipdw-validation.
-->

```{r}
#| label: tbl-ipdw-validation
#| tbl-cap: "Selected IPDW parameters and repeated spatial cross-validation performance. Values in parentheses are standard deviations across random spatial partitions."
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

validation_summary <- imap_dfr(
  model_stats,
  \(stats, parameter) {
    selected_power <- stats$dist_power[[1]]
    selected_range <- stats$max_range[[1]]

    repeated_results <- sensitivity_results[[parameter]]$summary |>
      filter(
        near(dist_power, selected_power),
        max_range == selected_range
      ) |>
      slice(1)

    if (nrow(repeated_results) != 1) {
      stop("Selected parameter combination is missing for ", parameter)
    }

    tibble(
      Parameter = parameter,
      Units = parameter_units[[parameter]],
      `Distance power` = selected_power,
      `Maximum range (km)` = selected_range / 1000,
      `Mean MAE (SD)` = sprintf(
        "%.3f (%.3f)",
        repeated_results$mean_MAE,
        repeated_results$sd_MAE
      ),
      `Mean RMSE (SD)` = sprintf(
        "%.3f (%.3f)",
        repeated_results$mean_RMSE,
        repeated_results$sd_RMSE
      ),
      `Mean bias` = sprintf(
        "%.3f",
        repeated_results$mean_Bias
      ),
      `Mean coverage` = scales::percent(
        repeated_results$mean_coverage,
        accuracy = 0.1
      )
    )
  }
)

kable(
  validation_summary,
  booktabs = TRUE,
  align = c("l", "l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r")
)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-raster-summary
#| tbl-cap: "Summary of final IPDW environmental predictor rasters."
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

raster_summary <- imap_dfr(
  raster_results,
  \(raster_layer, parameter) {
    raster_values <- getValues(raster_layer)
    raster_resolution <- res(raster_layer)

    tibble(
      Parameter = parameter,
      Units = parameter_units[[parameter]],
      Minimum = min(raster_values, na.rm = TRUE),
      Maximum = max(raster_values, na.rm = TRUE),
      `Predicted cells` = sum(!is.na(raster_values)),
      `Cell size` = paste0(
        raster_resolution[[1]],
        " x ",
        raster_resolution[[2]],
        " m"
      )
    )
  }
) |>
  mutate(
    Minimum = sprintf("%.2f", Minimum),
    Maximum = sprintf("%.2f", Maximum),
    `Predicted cells` = scales::comma(`Predicted cells`)
  )

kable(
  raster_summary,
  booktabs = TRUE,
  align = c("l", "l", "r", "r", "r", "c")
)
```

#| label: fig-environmental-rasters

)

old_par <- par(

      box = FALSE
    )
  }
)

par(old_par)

```{r}
#| label: fig-variable-importance
#| fig-cap: "Relative contribution and permutation importance of environmental predictors in the selected MaxEnt model."
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 6
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| eval: false

variable_importance <- readRDS(
  here("2-data", "models", "maxent_variable_importance.rds")
)

importance_long <- variable_importance |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(contribution, permutation_importance),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "importance"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    metric = recode(
      metric,
      contribution = "Contribution",
      permutation_importance = "Permutation importance"
    ),
    variable = fct_reorder(variable, importance, .fun = max)
  )

ggplot(
  importance_long,
  aes(
    x = importance,
    y = variable,
    fill = metric
  )
) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#2166AC", "#B2182B")) +
  labs(
    x = "Importance (%)",
    y = NULL,
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
```

## Comparison with the Existing HSI

<!--
Expected files:

2-data/models/maxent_suitability.rds
2-data/models/hsi_suitability.rds

Both rasters must use the same CRS, resolution, origin, extent, alignment, mask, and a 0 to 1 scale before this Results code is run.

Narrative to add:

- Report the cell-level correlation and difference metrics.
- Describe the overall spatial agreement.
- Identify where MaxEnt predicts greater or lower suitability than the HSI.
- Refer to Table @tbl-hsi-comparison and Figures @fig-hsi-comparison and @fig-hsi-scatter.
-->

```{r}
#| label: tbl-hsi-comparison
#| tbl-cap: "Cell-level comparison between MaxEnt and HSI habitat-suitability predictions."
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| eval: false

maxent_suitability <- readRDS(
  here("2-data", "models", "maxent_suitability.rds")
)

hsi_suitability <- readRDS(
  here("2-data", "models", "hsi_suitability.rds")
)

compareRaster(
  maxent_suitability,
  hsi_suitability,
  extent = TRUE,
  rowcol = TRUE,
  crs = TRUE,
  res = TRUE,
  orig = TRUE,
  stopiffalse = TRUE
)

comparison_data <- tibble(
  maxent = getValues(maxent_suitability),
  hsi = getValues(hsi_suitability)
) |>
  drop_na()

hsi_comparison <- tibble(
  Metric = c(
    "Pearson correlation",
    "Spearman correlation",
    "Mean signed difference",
    "Mean absolute difference",
    "Root mean square difference",
    "Cells within 0.10 suitability units"
  ),
  Value = c(
    sprintf("%.3f", cor(comparison_data$maxent, comparison_data$hsi)),
    sprintf(
      "%.3f",
      cor(
        comparison_data$maxent,
        comparison_data$hsi,
        method = "spearman"
      )
    ),
    sprintf(
      "%.3f",
      mean(comparison_data$maxent - comparison_data$hsi)
    ),
    sprintf(
      "%.3f",
      mean(abs(comparison_data$maxent - comparison_data$hsi))
    ),
    sprintf(
      "%.3f",
      sqrt(mean((comparison_data$maxent - comparison_data$hsi)^2))
    ),
    scales::percent(
      mean(abs(comparison_data$maxent - comparison_data$hsi) <= 0.10),
      accuracy = 0.1
    )
  )
)

kable(
  hsi_comparison,
  booktabs = TRUE,
  align = c("l", "r")
)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-hsi-comparison
#| fig-cap: "Spatial comparison of MaxEnt and HSI habitat-suitability predictions. Positive differences indicate greater suitability predicted by MaxEnt."
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 5
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| eval: false

suitability_difference <- maxent_suitability - hsi_suitability

difference_limit <- max(
  abs(range(getValues(suitability_difference), na.rm = TRUE))
)

old_par <- par(
  mfrow = c(1, 3),
  mar = c(2, 2, 3, 5)
)

raster::plot(
  maxent_suitability,
  col = hcl.colors(100, "YlGn"),
  zlim = c(0, 1),
  main = "MaxEnt",
  axes = FALSE,
  box = FALSE
)

raster::plot(
  hsi_suitability,
  col = hcl.colors(100, "YlGn"),
  zlim = c(0, 1),
  main = "HSI",
  axes = FALSE,
  box = FALSE
)

raster::plot(
  suitability_difference,
  col = hcl.colors(100, "Blue-Red 3"),
  zlim = c(-difference_limit, difference_limit),
  main = "MaxEnt minus HSI",
  axes = FALSE,
  box = FALSE
)

par(old_par)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-hsi-scatter
#| fig-cap: "Cell-level relationship between MaxEnt and HSI habitat-suitability predictions. The dashed line represents perfect agreement."
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 6
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| eval: false

set.seed(42)

comparison_plot_data <- comparison_data |>
  slice_sample(n = min(20000, n()))

ggplot(
  comparison_plot_data,
  aes(
    x = hsi,
    y = maxent
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    color = "#2166AC",
    alpha = 0.15,
    size = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_abline(
    slope = 1,
    intercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey30"
  ) +
  coord_equal(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "HSI suitability",
    y = "MaxEnt suitability"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
